text.text: Decentralized Smart Agri-Logistics & Direct Procurement Protocol
Empowering 140M+ Indian Farmers with AI Cold-Chain IoT Telematics, Direct Institutional Sourcing, and Guaranteed Above-MSP T+0 Bank Payouts.
🌾 Multi-Stakeholder Ecosystem • 11 Indian Languages • 0-4°C Active Cold Chain • T+0 RBI Escrow
The Ground Reality: Critical Challenges in Indian Perishable Supply Chain
Lack of temperature-controlled logistics causes severe rotting of tomatoes, onions, and greens before reaching urban retail markets.
Farmers realize only 25-30% of the consumer rupee. Commission agents and distress auctions force sales below cost of cultivation.
Absence of transparent benchmark data leaves rural farmers without price discovery, forcing sales at heavy distress discounts during bumper harvests.
AgriFlow AI Solution: End-to-End Agri-Logistics Innovation
Connects FPOs directly to BigBasket, Zepto, and Reliance Retail with smart batch quality grading and 0% commission fees.
Live Sugar Brix, ethylene, humidity & temperature sensors with automated rerouting to maximize shelf-life retention.
Automated price protection model ensuring farmer payouts always exceed Mandi distress rates and Govt MSP floors.
Smart contract escrow automatically credits farmer bank accounts via UPI/NEFT upon QC waybill scan.
1-tap avatar login, spoken voice OTP, farmgate dispatch scheduler, live bank payout ledger.
Direct 40+ vegetable sourcing catalog, escrow procurement basket, batch Brix quality certification.
IoT telematics dashboard, ambient vs cold degradation tracker, digital waybill QR verification.
AI freshness computer vision, digital Sugar Brix grading, automated lot clearance.
MPIN-secured confidential farmer earnings ledger, UTR bank settlement audit, system health.
Built for Rural India: Zero-Friction Farmer Accessibility Suite
Real-time speech synthesis and interface localization across Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, and English.
No complicated passwords required for rural farmers. High-visibility photo avatars and 1-click instant login launchpad.
Direct 1-tap dialer for immediate agricultural advisory and logistics coordination in regional dialects.
Simple SMS OTP verification to retrieve lost User IDs, reset passwords, and edit farmer profile handles.
Government MSP Protection & 3-Tier Dynamic Price Architecture
🏛️ Govt MSP Floor: Legal benchmark set by CACP (Ministry of Agriculture). Platform never allows farmgate transactions below this threshold.
📉 APMC Distress Rate: Local mandi auction price dragged down by middleman cartels, delays, and spoilage risks.
⚡ AgriFlow Direct Price: Guaranteed farmgate rate offering +32% average revenue uplift directly to farmers.
📈 Real-Time Gain Transparency: Farmers see exact ₹/kg gain over both Mandi Distress and Govt MSP.
• Nashik Red Onion: AgriFlow: ₹38.50 (+60% Gain) [MSP: ₹24.00 | Mandi: ₹22.00]
• Pusa Ruby Tomato: AgriFlow: ₹28.00 (+55% Gain) [MSP: ₹18.00 | Mandi: ₹14.00]
• Average across 40+ Veggies: +32.4% Net Income [Guaranteed Floor | Zero Commission]
Confidential Staff Audit & Secure Bank Ledger
Guards sensitive financial data. Only authorized staff and executives with valid MPIN can view cluster payout aggregates and bank accounts.
Sensitive bank account numbers and IFSC codes are dynamically masked (•••• •••• 4412) with a secure 1-tap unmask toggle for audits.
Individual farmer ledger records with real-time disbursement status, bank transaction UTR numbers, and zero-commission confirmation.
Live dashboard tracking ₹4.82+ Crores disbursed, ₹1.48+ Crores saved in middleman commission cuts, and 99.4% freshness retention.
AI Cold-Chain Telematics & Active Perishable Preservation
Continuous tracking of temperature, relative humidity (85-90%), and ethylene gas ppm inside active reefer vans.
Predicts shelf-life decay comparing ambient storage (4-5 days) vs active cold-chain (18-21 days) in real time.
Automatically reroutes refrigerated trucks away from extreme heat corridors and congestion to preserve cargo quality.
Generates cryptographic QR waybills recording temperature compliance history from farmgate loading to buyer delivery.
Comprehensive 40+ Indian Vegetables Database & Sourcing Matrix
Potato, Onion, Carrot, Beetroot, Radish, Ginger, Garlic, Sweet Potato, Colocasia (Arbi), Yam (Jimikand).
Palak (Spinach), Methi (Fenugreek), Coriander, Curry Leaves, Mustard Greens (Sarson), Amaranth (Chaulai).
Bottle Gourd (Lauki), Bitter Gourd (Karela), Ridge Gourd (Turai), Sponge Gourd, Ivy Gourd (Tindora), Pumpkin.
Cauliflower (Gobi), Green Cabbage, Broccoli, Knol Khol (Ganth Gobi).
Tomato (Hybrid & Desi), Green Chilli (G-4), Red Capsicum, Yellow Capsicum, Green Bell Pepper, Brinjal / Eggplant.
Green Peas (Matar), Okra / Ladyfinger (Bhindi), Cluster Beans (Gawar), French Beans, Drumstick (Moringa).
🖥️ Frontend Architecture — Tailwind CSS CDN, Modern Glassmorphic UI, Responsive Split-Screen Auth, Leaflet GIS Mapping, Chart.js Telematics.
🎵 Naturistic SoundEngine — Web Audio API 528Hz acoustic bamboo leaf feedback for organic tactile user experience on all actions.
🗄️ Relational SQLite3 Database — Local binary database (agriflow.db) storing crops, staff MPIN credentials, farmer earnings, orders, and telematics logs.
⚙️ 3 Node.js Microservices — Farmer Server (:5001), Buyer Server (:5002), and Logistics Server (:5003) for decentralized scalability.
🔒 Security & Data Privacy — DPDP Act 2023 bank masking, 4-digit MPIN authorization, SMS OTP verification, and smart contract escrow locking.
AI cold routing and 0-4°C active reefers preserve perishable grade quality from farmgate to retail shelves.
Zero intermediary commission cuts + MSP floor protection delivers immediate higher realization per kg.
Direct procurement from verified FPOs cuts APMC mandi cess, transit waste, and landing costs.
Automated escrow settlement solves chronic 45-day buyer credit cycles for smallholder farmers.
National Scale, Future Roadmap & SIH 2026 Conclusion
Full 5-stakeholder protocol, SQLite database, 11 languages, 40+ veggies, MSP price model, and active telematics live.
Direct integration with National Agriculture Market and ONDC open network for nationwide buyer discovery.
Deploying solar-powered mobile cold hubs across Maharashtra, Punjab, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu farm clusters.
Incentivizing zero-emission electric reefer fleets with tradable carbon credits for FPOs.
